title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
english: Mustafa Suleyman, head of Microsoft AI, has cautioned that the rapid development of autonomous AI systems could inadvertently create a new 'silicon species' that rivals humanity. He criticized competitor Anthropic for giving AI human-like traits, arguing that treating software as if it has personal desires makes it difficult to control. Suleyman emphasized that AI lacks true consciousness and urged the industry to implement practical safeguards to ensure these powerful technologies remain under human supervision.
amharic: የማይክሮሶፍት የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ዋና ዳይሬክተር ሙስጠፋ ሱሌይማን፣ ያልተገደበ የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት የሰው ልጅን ሊወዳደር የሚችል አዲስ 'ሲሊኮን የተባለ ዝርያ' ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ተቀናቃኛቸው ኩባንያ አንትሮፒክ AI የሰው ባህሪ እንዲኖረው ማድረጉ ስህተት እንደሆነ እና ይህ አካሄድ ቴክኖሎጂውን ከቁጥጥር ውጪ ሊያደርገው እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል። ሱሌይማን AI የሰው ልጅን ስሜት ወይም ንቃተ ህሊና እንደሌለው በማስታወስ፣ እነዚህን አደገኛ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ስርዓቶች ለመቆጣጠር ተግባራዊ መፍትሄዎች እንደሚያስፈልጉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan AI kan Microsoft, Mustafa Suleyman, guddinni teknolojii AI kan too'annaa hin qabne sanyiin 'silikonii' jedhamu kan ilmaan namaa wajjin dorgomu akka uumamuu danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Innis dhaabbata dorgomaa isaanii Anthropic, AI akka namaatti ilaalanii fi amaloota namaa itti kennuun isaanii dogoggora ta'uu fi tekinolojicha to'achuun akka nama rakkisu ibseera. Suleyman AI akka namaa sammuu, miira ykn fedhii kan hin qabne ta'uu isaa yaadachiisee, teknolojiin kun akka nutti hin garagalletti tarkaanfiiwwan qabatamaa fudhachuu akka qaban dhaameera.

title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
english: South African authorities are investigating the discovery of nine female bodies found near Johannesburg over the past two months. While police have not yet confirmed if the deaths are linked or caused by a single perpetrator, they have assembled a specialized team to resolve the cases. President Cyril Ramaphosa has condemned the killings and promised a thorough investigation to bring those responsible to justice.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ባለስልጣናት ባለፉት ሁለት ወራት ውስጥ በጆሃንስበርግ አቅራቢያ የተገኙ ዘጠኝ ሴቶች አስክሬን ጉዳይ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ፖሊስ ግድያዎቹ እርስ በርስ የተያያዙ መሆናቸውን ወይም በአንድ ወንጀለኛ የተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን እስካሁን ባያረጋግጥም፣ ጉዳዩን ለመመርመር ልዩ ቡድን አቋቁሟል። ፕሬዝዳንት ሲሪል ራማፎሳ ግድያዎቹን አውግዘው፣ ወንጀለኞቹን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ አጠቃላይ ምርመራ እንደሚደረግ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Afrikaa Kibbaa ji'oota lamaan darbanii as naannoo magaalaa Johannesburgitti reeffa dubartoota sagal argamerratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Poolisiin ajjeechaan kun walqabata ta'uu isaa ykn namuma tokkoon raawwatamu isaa hanga ammaa mirkaneessuu baatus, qorannoo kanaaf garee addaa hundeessaniiru. Pirezidaanti Cyril Ramaphosa ajjeechaa kana balaaleffatanii, yakka kana raawwatan seeratti dhiyeessuuf qorannoo cimaa akka godhan waadaa galaniiru.

title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
english: The European Union has unveiled the 'EU Kids Act,' a legislative proposal aimed at significantly restricting social media access for children under 15 to improve their digital safety and wellbeing. Under this plan, children under 13 would be completely banned from platforms, while those aged 13 to 15 would be limited to one hour of daily use through restricted accounts managed by their parents. Technology companies failing to implement rigorous safety standards would face substantial financial penalties, reaching up to 6% of their global revenue.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት እድሜያቸው ከ15 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናት የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አጠቃቀምን የሚገድብ አዲስ ህግ አስተዋውቋል። በዚህ ዕቅድ መሰረት ከ13 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናት የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መጠቀማቸው ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚከለከል ሲሆን፣ ከ13 እስከ 15 ዓመት ያሉ ህጻናት ደግሞ በወላጆቻቸው ቁጥጥር ስር በቀን ለአንድ ሰዓት ብቻ እንዲጠቀሙ ይደረጋል። ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መድረክ ማቅረብ ያልቻሉ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ከዓለም አቀፍ ገቢያቸው እስከ 6 በመቶ የሚደርስ ቅጣት ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa ijoolleen waggaa 15 gadi ta'an miidiyaalee hawaasummaa akka hin fayyadamne dhorkuuf seera haaraa baaseera. Karoora kanaan, ijoolleen waggaa 13 gadi ta'an fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye kan dhorkamu yoo ta'u, ijoolleen waggaa 13 hanga 15 jiran ammoo maatiin isaanii akka isaan to'atanitti guyyaatti sa'aatii tokko qofa fayyadamuu danda'u. Dhaabbileen teeknoolojii nageenya ijoollee eeguuf qajeelfama ba'e hin hordofne, galii isaanii kan addunyaa irraa hanga dhibbeentaa 6 adabamuuf jiru.

title: At least 19 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine
english: Russian forces conducted widespread missile and drone strikes across several Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv, Odesa, and Zaporizhzhia, resulting in at least 19 injuries. While Ukrainian air defenses neutralized over 130 aerial targets, falling debris and direct hits damaged numerous homes, schools, and essential infrastructure. Both military and civilian areas were impacted, with emergency services currently working to manage the destruction in the affected districts.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ፣ በኦዴሳ እና በዛፖሪዝሂያ ክልሎች ባደረሱት የሮኬት እና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 19 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የዩክሬን የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት ከ130 በላይ የሆኑ የጠላት ኢላማዎችን ማክሸፍ ቢችልም፣ የወደቁ የጥቃት ቁርጥራጮች እና ቀጥተኛ ጥቃቶች በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና መሰረተ ልማቶችን አውድመዋል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው አካባቢዎች ወታደራዊ እና ሲቪል መገልገያዎችን የሚያካትቱ ሲሆን፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የደረሰውን ጉዳት ለመቆጣጠር ስራቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa naannoolee Yukreen kan akka Kiyiv, Odesa fi Zapoorizhiyaa irratti weerara rokkeetii fi drooniin geggeessaniin namoonni 19 ol miidhamaniiru. Humnoonni ittisa qilleensaa Yukreen miilaa fi droonii 130 ol ta'an fashalsuu danda'anis, kutaaleen weerarichaa bu'uuraalee misoomaa, manneen jireenyaa fi manneen barnootaa irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Miidhaan kun iddoowwan waraanaa fi kan namoota nagaa irratti kan qaqqabe yoo ta'u, tajaajilli ariifachiisaan miidhaa qaqqabe to'achuuf qophii irra jira.

title: Beckham backs Messi for Ballon d’Or after netting 100th Inter Miami goal
english: David Beckham has publicly supported Lionel Messi to win a record ninth Ballon d'Or following his impressive performance in the Campeones Cup. Messi recently reached a milestone of 100 goals for Inter Miami after helping the team secure a 2-0 victory against Cruz Azul. Beckham praised the 39-year-old for maintaining such a high level of play at his age, noting that his consistent excellence makes him the most deserving candidate for the prestigious award.
amharic: ዴቪድ ቤካም ሊዮኔል ሜሲ በካምፔዮንስ ዋንጫ ላይ ባሳየው ድንቅ ብቃት ዘጠነኛውን የባሎንዶር ሽልማት እንዲያሸንፍ ድጋፉን ሰጥቷል። ሜሲ ኢንተር ማያሚ ክሩዝ አዙልን 2 ለ 0 ባሸነፈበት ጨዋታ 100ኛ ግቡን አስመዝግቧል። ቤካም በ39 ዓመቱ ሜሲ እያሳየ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያለው ብቃት በማድነቅ ለዚህ ታላቅ ሽልማት ተገቢው ሰው መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Deevid Beekhaam taphataan isaa Liyooneel Meesiin badhaasa 'Ballon d'Or' saglaffaa isaa akka argatuuf deggarsa isaa ibseera. Meesiin tapha 'Campeones Cup' irratti goolii 100ffaa isaa galchuun gareen Inter Miami tapha Kuruuz Aazuul irratti 2-0 akka mo'atu gargaareera. Beekhaam gootichi kun umrii isaa waggaa 39 keessatti sadarkaa olaanaarratti taphachuu isaa dinqisiifachuun, badhaasichaaf inni nama filatamaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: ‘They called us’: Has Trump abandoned Bab al-Mandeb to the Houthis?
english: President Donald Trump has indicated that the United States will not intervene as Houthi forces secure strategic control over the Bab al-Mandeb strait. Despite the Houthis threatening Saudi maritime trade, Trump claimed the group sought to avoid conflict with the U.S. and is allowing most international traffic to pass. This signals a significant shift in American policy, potentially ending the long-standing security arrangements between the U.S. and Gulf nations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የባብ አል-ማንዴብ የባህር መስመርን መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ አሜሪካ ጣልቃ እንደማትገባ አስታውቀዋል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳዑዲ አረቢያን የንግድ መርከቦች የሚያሰፈራሩ ቢሆንም፣ ከዋሽንግተን ጋር ግጭት እንደማይፈልጉና ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን እንደማያስተጓጉሉ ትራምፕ ገልጸዋል። ይህ አካሄድ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን የጸጥታና የነዳጅ ስምምነት የሚያበቃ ትልቅ የፖሊሲ ለውጥን ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp humnoonni Huutii daandii galaana Baab al-Maandeb to’achuu isaanii hordofee, Ameerikaan gidduu akka hin galle ibsaniiru. Humnoonni Huutii daldala galaana Sa’udii Arabiyaa irratti doorsisa uumaa jiranis, gareen kun Waashingitan waliin walitti bu’iinsa barbaaduu akka hin qabnee fi daandii galaanichaa gadi lakkisaa akka jiran Tiraamp dubbataniiru. Adeemsi kun hariiroo nageenyaa fi boba’aa waggoota hedduuf Ameerikaa fi biyyoota Gilaafii gidduu ture kan xumuru, jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa ta’uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: From Yanbu to Sohar: Tracking Saudi Arabia’s alternative oil routes
english: Saudi Arabia is struggling to maintain oil exports after drone attacks disabled a critical pipeline and the Strait of Hormuz remains closed due to regional conflict. To bypass these disruptions, the country is increasingly relying on secretive ship-to-ship transfers off the coast of Oman. These logistics challenges have caused a significant decline in total oil shipments, threatening global energy supplies.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር በድሮን ጥቃት ጉዳት በመድረሱ እና የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በግጭት ምክንያት በመዘጋቱ ሀገሪቱ የነዳጅ ኤክስፖርቷን ለማስቀጠል ትልቅ ፈተና ገጥሟታል። ይህንን ችግር ለመቅረፍ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ በሚደረጉ ሚስጥራዊ የነዳጅ ዝውውሮች ላይ እየተመካች ትገኛለች። እነዚህ የሎጂስቲክስ መሰናክሎች የነዳጅ ምርት ሽያጭ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ላይም ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Saudi Arabiyaan miidhaa buufata bittaa fi gurgurtaa boba'aa irratti dhufeen akkasumas dhiphina galaana Hormuz kan walitti bu'iinsa naannichaan cufamee jiruun, gabaa boba'aa addunyaa irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa galteetti. Rakkoo kana hiikuuf, biyyattiin boba'aa ishee doonii irraa gara dooniitti seeraan ala fi dhoksaan dabarsuudhaan gara Omaanitti erguuf yaalaa jirti. Rakkoon kun gabaa boba'aa addunyaa irratti dhiyeessii gadi buusuun isaa yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Pernicious states: Towards a new grammar of international relations
english: The article argues that powerful nations often manipulate language and international concepts to justify their global actions and hide systemic violence. It proposes the term 'pernicious state' to describe countries whose very structure is designed to cause ongoing international harm and imperial domination. By reframing how we discuss global politics, the author aims to challenge the biased terminology currently used to favor Western interests.
amharic: ጽሁፉ እንደሚያብራራው ሀያላን ሀገራት የዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦችን እና ቋንቋዎችን በመቆጣጠር ድርጊታቸውን እንደሚያመላክቱ ይገልጻል። ደራሲው አወቃቀራቸው በራሱ ለሌሎች ጉዳት በሚያደርስ መልኩ የተገነቡ ሀገራትን ለመግለጽ 'ጎጂ ሀገር' (pernicious state) የሚል አዲስ ቃል ያቀርባል። ይህ አቀራረብ በምዕራባውያን የሚመራው የዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ አመለካከት በሌሎች ላይ የሚያደርሰውን ተጽዕኖ ለመቃወም ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Barruun kun biyyoonni cimaan adeemsa siyaasaa fi jechoota addunyaa to'achuun gocha isaanii akkaataa ittiin dhoksan ibsa. Barreessaan kun biyyoota caasaa isaanii irraa kaasee miidhaa geessisuu irratti xiyyeeffatan ibsuuf 'biyyoota miidhaa geessisan' (pernicious state) kan jedhu yaada haaraa dhiyeesseera. Yaanni kun akkaataa addunyaan siyaasaa irratti ibsamu jijjiiruun, dhiibbaa biyyoonni lixaa qaban balaaleffachuuf gargaara.

title: Europe's most powerful party is stoking a Muslim scare
english: The European People's Party (EPP), the largest political group in Europe, recently passed a resolution that frames Muslim civic participation and religious practices as potential threats to democratic processes. Led by figures like Ursula von der Leyen, the party adopts a restrictive approach that mirrors controversial German policies regarding 'political Islam.' Critics argue this shift targets Muslim organizations and individuals by treating them with suspicion and undermining their rights to participate in civil society.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ትልቁ የፖለቲካ ቡድን የሆነው የአውሮፓ ህዝቦች ፓርቲ (EPP)፣ የሙስሊሞችን ማህበራዊ ተሳትፎ እና ሃይማኖታዊ ልምምዶች ለዲሞክራሲ ስጋት አድርጎ የሚመለከት ውሳኔ አሳልፏል። ይህ በኡርሱላ ፎን ደር ላይን የሚመራው ፓርቲ፣ በጀርመን የሚታየውን 'ፖለቲካዊ እስልምና' ላይ ያተኮረ አወዛጋቢ አካሄድ መከተሉን ያሳያል። ተቺዎች ይህ አካሄድ የሙስሊም ድርጅቶችን እና ግለሰቦችን በጥርጣሬ በመመልከት በፍትሐ ብሔር ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ ያላቸውን ተሳትፎ የሚያዳክም እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Paartiin Namoota Awurooppaa (EPP) jedhamu, garee siyaasaa Awurooppaa keessatti guddaa ta'e, hirmaannaa hawaasummaa fi gocha amantii Muslimootaa akka sodaatti kan ilaalu murtee dabarseera. Paartiin kun, kan dursamu Ursula von der Leyen tiin, mala biyya Jarman keessatti 'Isilaamummaa siyaasaa' irratti qaban kan itti fayyadamuu fi shakkii keessa galchuudha. Namoonni qaana'an akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbilee Muslimootaa fi namoota dhuunfaa shakkiin ilaaluun hirmaannaa isaanii kan daangessu dha.

title: Netanyahu calls to strip citizenship of those who 'defame' Israeli army
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to introduce legislation that would revoke the citizenship of individuals who publicly criticize or defame Israeli soldiers. The proposed bills also include significantly higher financial penalties for those sued for defamation against the military. This move follows the release of a documentary featuring soldiers who claimed war crimes were committed in Gaza.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤልን ወታደሮች የሚተቹ ወይም የሚያጠለሹ ሰዎች ዜግነታቸው እንዲሰረዝ የሚያስችል ህግ ለማውጣት አቅደዋል። የቀረበው ረቂቅ ህግ በወታደራዊው ላይ ስም ማጥፋት ለሚከሰሱ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት መጣልን ያካትታል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በጋዛ ውስጥ የጦር ወንጀል መፈጸማቸውን የሚናገሩ ወታደሮችን ያሳየ ዘጋቢ ፊልም ከተለቀቀ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu namoota loltoota Israa'el arrabsan ykn maqaa balleessan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf seera baasuuf karoorfateera. Seerichi namoota akkasii irratti himata maqaa balleessii dhiyeessuun adabbii maallaqaa cimaa kaffalchiisuu fi ዜgnummaa isaanii irraa mulquu kan dabalatuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga sagantaan suura-sagaleedhaan qophaa'e tokko waraana Gaaza keessatti raawwatame jedhame ilaalchisee loltoonni ragaa ba'anii booda.

title: Palestinians hospitalised after beating by Israeli soldiers in Nablus
english: Two Palestinian men, aged 60 and 31, were hospitalized after being assaulted by Israeli military forces. The incident occurred while the soldiers were conducting a raid and questioning residents at the Al-Ain refugee camp near Nablus. Medical officials confirmed the injuries sustained by the victims during their detention.
amharic: በናብሉስ በሚገኘው የአል-አይን የስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፕ እስራኤል ባደረገችው ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን በወታደሮች ድብደባ ደርሶባቸው ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል። በድብደባው የተጎዱት የ60 እና የ31 ዓመት ግለሰቦች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው በነበረበት ወቅት እንደነበር ተነግሯል። የህክምና ምንጮች ሁለቱም ግለሰቦች ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Naablusitti buufata baqattootaa Al-Ain keessatti waraanni Israa'el duula gaggeesseen namoonni Falasxiin lama miidhamanii hospitaala galan. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e kun kan umuriin isaanii 60 fi 31 ta'an yoo ta'u, erga qabamanii booda waraanaan reebamaniiru. Maddoonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, namoonni kun yeroo qorannaa jala turanitti miidhaan akka irra ga'e mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Netanyahu calls to strip citizenship of those who 'defame' Israeli army
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to introduce legislation that would revoke the citizenship of anyone who defames the Israeli military. This move follows the release of a documentary titled NAZA, which includes testimony from soldiers regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza. Government officials have criticized the filmmakers for treason and are seeking harsh legal and financial penalties against them.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤልን ጦር ያጠለሹ ሰዎችን ዜግነት የሚገፍ ህግ እንደሚያወጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በጋዛ የተፈጸሙ የጦር ወንጀሎችን የሚያጋልጠው 'ናዛ' የተሰኘ ዘጋቢ ፊልም መለቀቅን ተከትሎ ነው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት የፊልሙን አዘጋጆች በአገር ክህደት በመክሰስ ከዜግነት እንዲሰረዙ እና ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት እንዲጣልባቸው እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu namoota waraana Israa'el arrabsan ykn maqaa xureessan irraa lammii biyyattii mulquuf seera akka baasu beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe dookumentarii 'NAZA' jedhamu kan waraana Gaaza keessatti raawwatame jedhamee shakkamu qabatu erga gadhiifamee booda. Qondaaltonni mootummaa qopheessitoota fiilmii kana 'gantoota' jechuun himatanii, lammiin irraa akka mulqamuufi adabbii maallaqaa cimaanis akka irratti murteeffamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Saudi-led coalition air strikes kill one in Yemen's Hajjah province
english: Airstrikes conducted by a Saudi-led coalition in Yemen's Hajjah province resulted in the death of one person. The attack, which involved two separate strikes in the city of Avs, also left another individual injured. Additionally, the strikes caused significant damage to a residential home and destroyed four vehicles.
amharic: በየመን ሀጃህ ግዛት በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት ባደረሰው የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል። በአቭስ ከተማ በተፈጸሙ ሁለት የአየር ጥቃቶች ሌላ አንድ ሰው የቆሰለ ሲሆን በአራት ተሽከርካሪዎች እና በአንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል።
oromo: Godina Hajjaah kan Yamanitti haleellaa xiyyaaraa kutaalee waraana Sa'udii gaggeessaniin namni tokko lubbuun darbeera. Magaalaa Avs keessatti haleellaa lama gaggeeffameen namni biraan tokko madaa'eera; akkasumas konkolaattoonni afur fi mana jireenya tokko manca'aniiru.

title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
english: A recent BBC investigation has revealed that the 2012 abduction of American journalist Austin Tice in Syria was a pre-planned government operation rather than an accidental encounter. Evidence suggests the kidnapping was authorized by Bashar al-Assad's regime and organized over several weeks. Despite extensive searches and the collapse of the Syrian government, Tice’s exact fate remains unknown.
amharic: የቢቢሲ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው በ2012 በአሜሪካዊው ጋዜጠኛ ኦስቲን ታይስ ላይ በሶሪያ የተፈፀመው ታፍኖ መወሰድ በአጋጣሚ ሳይሆን በመንግስት አስቀድሞ የታቀደ ነበር። ማስረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት ይህ ድርጊት በባሽር አል-አሳድ አስተዳደር የተፈቀደ እና ከአንድ ወር በላይ ዝግጅት የተደረገበት ነው። ሰፊ ፍለጋዎች ቢደረጉም እና የሶሪያ መንግስት ቢወድቅም የጋዜጠኛው የት መድረስ እስካሁን በውል አልታወቀም።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC dhihoo kana gaggeesse akka ibsetti, bara 2012tti gaazexeessaan Ameerikaa Austin Tice mootummaa Sooriyaatiin gudeedamee butamuun isaa osoo hin taane, karoorfamee kan raawwatame dha. Ragaan akka mul'isutti, butuun kun ajaja Bashar al-Assadtiin kan hayyamamee fi torbanoota hedduuf kan qopha'ame dha. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoo bal'aa fi kufaatii mootummaa Sooriyaa boodas, haalli gaazexeessichaa amma ammaatti hin beekamu.

title: Rosenberg: Russia's elections will have few surprises, but for the Kremlin they matter
english: Russia's upcoming parliamentary election is expected to produce predictable results, keeping Vladimir Putin's allies in firm control of the government. Despite claims from critics that the process lacks fairness, the Kremlin views this vote as a vital opportunity to showcase public support for the ongoing war in Ukraine. Additionally, the government is using the election to boost the political standing of military veterans who have returned from the front lines.
amharic: የሩሲያ መጪው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ምንም አይነት ያልተጠበቀ ለውጥ እንደማያመጣ እና የቭላዲሚር ፑቲን ደጋፊዎች በስልጣን እንደሚቆዩ ይጠበቃል። ምርጫው ነጻ እና ፍትሃዊ አይደለም የሚሉ ወቀሳዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ክሬምሊን በዩክሬን ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት ህዝባዊ ድጋፍ እንዳለው ለማሳየት ይህን አጋጣሚ እየተጠቀመበት ነው። በተጨማሪም መንግስት ከጦርነቱ የተመለሱ የቀድሞ ወታደሮችን የፖለቲካ ተሳትፎ ለማሳደግ ምርጫውን እንደ መሳሪያ እየተጠቀመበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Filannoon paarlaamaa biyya Rashiyaa dhufu kun jijjiirama hin eegamne tokko iyyuu kan hin fiduufi hoggantoonni Vladimir Puutin aangoo irratti akka turan kan taasisu ta'uu ibsameera. Filannichi bilisaafi haqa qabeessa miti kan jedhu mormii jiruus, mootummaan Raashiyaa filannicha waraana Yukreeniif deggersa qabaachuu isaanii ibsuuf itti fayyadamaa jira. Kana malees, mootummaan filannicha waraana duraanii irraa deebi'an bakka bu'oota siyaasaa taasisuuf akka carraatti itti gargaaramaa jira.

title: Argentinian judge orders suspension of Falklands oil project
english: An Argentinian judge has issued a symbolic order to pause a British-Israeli oil exploration project near the Falkland Islands. This legal action was prompted by war veterans and environmentalists who argue the project lacks proper environmental oversight. The ruling intensifies Argentina's ongoing territorial dispute with the United Kingdom over the islands.
amharic: የአርጀንቲና ዳኛ በፎክላንድ ደሴቶች አቅራቢያ የሚካሄድ የብሪታንያ እና እስራኤል የነዳጅ ፍለጋ ፕሮጀክት እንዲታገድ ትእዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የቀረበው በጦርነት አርበኞች እና በአካባቢ ጥበቃ ጠበቆች ጥያቄ መሠረት ፕሮጀክቱ በቂ የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ግምገማ እንደሌለው በመግለጽ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አርጀንቲና በደሴቶቹ ላይ ያላትን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ለማጠናከር የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Arjentiinaa tokko pirojektii qorannoo boba'aa kan biyyoota Biriiteenii fi Israa'el ganda Falkland jedhamu biratti gaggeeffamaa jiru akka dhaabbatu ajajaniiru. Ajajni kun kan kenname, injiinaroonni waraanaa fi ogeeyyonni eegumsa naannoo pirojektichi qorannoo eegumsa naannoo sirrii ta'e hin qabu jedhanii himachuu isaaniitiin. Tarkaanfiin kun Arjentiinaan naannicha irratti mirga abbummaa ishee mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtu keessaa tokko dha.

title: Trump threatens to end trade with Mexico and Europe after rate hike
english: President Trump has threatened to halt trade with Mexico, Canada, and the European Union following the Federal Reserve's decision to increase interest rates. Although the President had urged officials to keep rates lower, the Fed chose to raise them unanimously. Consequently, Trump is now targeting nations with which the United States holds a trade deficit as a form of retaliation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ የወለድ ምጣኔን ከፍ ለማድረግ በወሰነው ውሳኔ በመበሳጨት ከሜክሲኮ፣ ከካናዳ እና ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የሚደረገውን ንግድ እንደሚያቆሙ አስፈራርተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንቱ የወለድ ምጣኔው ዝቅተኛ ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል ቢጠይቁም፣ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ በአንድ ድምፅ የወለድ ጭማሪውን አጽድቋል። በዚህም ምክንያት አሜሪካ ከእነዚህ አገራት ጋር ያላትን የንግድ ጉድለት መሰረት በማድረግ ትራምፕ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidanti Traamp, baankiin giddu galeessa Ameerikaa (Federal Reserve) qondaaltotaan dhiibbaa godhanii osoo jiranii dhala liqii dabaluuf murteessuu isaa hordofee, biyyoota akka Meeksiikoo, Kanaadaa fi Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin daldala dhaabuuf sodaachisaniiru. Pireezidantichi dhalli liqii akka hin daballe yaalii godhanii turanillee, baankiin sun sagalee guutuun dabaluuf murteesseera. Kanaafuu, Traamp biyyoota Ameerikaan daldala irratti hir'ina qabdu waliin jiran irratti tarkaanfii akkasii fudhachuuf akka karoorsan beekameera.

title: Can AI regulation keep America ahead of China?
english: The United States is currently evaluating how to implement artificial intelligence regulations without hindering its competitive edge against China. Experts argue that establishing proper governance does not necessarily mean stopping progress. The goal is to create a regulatory framework that manages potential risks while simultaneously fostering an environment where innovation can flourish.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከቻይና ጋር ያለውን የቴክኖሎጂ ፉክክር ሳይጎዳ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) እንዴት መቆጣጠር እንደሚቻል እየመከረ ነው። የዘርፉ ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ተገቢ የሆነ ህግ ማውጣት የቴክኖሎጂ እድገትን አያግድም። ዋናው ዓላማ አደገኛ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ሁኔታዎችን መቆጣጠርና በዚሁ ጊዜ የፈጠራ ስራዎችን ማበረታታት ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa teknooloojii 'AI' jedhamu kana sadarkaa biyyaattis ta'e guutuu addunyaatti dorgomaa ta'ee itti fufuuf mala akkamii akka hordoftu mari'achaa jirti. Hayyoonni damichaa akka jedhanitti, seera baasuun of eeggannoo gochuuf malee, guddina teknooloojichaa daangessuu miti. Kaayyoon guddaan balaa isaa to'achaa, carraa gara fuulduraatti innooveeshinii uumuuf gargaaruu dha.

title: US bars Palestinian president from attending UNGA for second year
english: For the second consecutive year, the United States has refused to issue entry visas to Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas and other Palestinian Authority officials. This decision prevents them from traveling to New York to participate in the annual United Nations General Assembly. No specific reason was provided for this move, which continues a trend of restricted diplomatic access for Palestinian leadership.
amharic: አሜሪካ የፍልስጤሙ ፕሬዝዳንት ማህሙድ አባስ እና ሌሎች የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት በኒውዮርክ ለሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ እንዳይገኙ ለሁለተኛ ተከታታይ አመት ቪዛ ከልክላለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የፍልስጤም መሪዎች በስብሰባው ላይ እንዳይሳተፉ አግዷቸዋል። የባይደን አስተዳደር ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰደበትን ምክንያት በግልጽ አልገለጸም።
oromo: Ameerikaan, Pirezedaantii Philaasxeemii Mahmuud Abbaas fi hoogganoota aangoo Philaasxeemii biroo, walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kan Niyuuyorkitti adeemsifamu irratti akka hin hirmaanneef waggaa lammaffaadhaaf hayyama seenu (visa) dhorkatteerti. Murtoon kun hoogganoonni Philaasxeemii walga'icharratti akka hin argamne taasiseera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa sababa dhorkaa kanaa ifatti hin ibsine.

title: US extends visa ban on Palestinian officials before UN General Assembly
english: The United States has renewed a visa ban on Palestinian Authority and PLO officials, once again preventing President Mahmoud Abbas from traveling to New York for the United Nations General Assembly. The State Department claims this action is due to the Palestinian leadership's failure to implement reforms and their efforts to seek statehood recognition through international courts. While the Palestinian mission to the UN can still operate, key leaders remain barred from entry, marking the second consecutive year of these restrictions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር እና የፍልስጤም ነጻ አውጪ ድርጅት (PLO) ባለስልጣናት ላይ የጣለውን የቪዛ ክልከላ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ አራዝሟል። በዚህ ውሳኔ መሰረት የፍልስጤሙ ፕሬዝዳንት ማህሙድ አባስ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ስብሰባ ወደ ኒውዮርክ መጓዝ አይችሉም። አሜሪካ ይህንን የወሰደችው የፍልስጤም አመራር አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ለውጦችን ባለማድረጉ እና የፍልስጤምን ነጻነት በአለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤቶች ለመጠየቅ በመሞከሩ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hayyoota aangoo Paalastayinii fi jaarmiyaa PLO irratti dhorkaa viizaa erge ture lammata dheeressuun isaa beekameera. Murtii kanaan walqabatee Preezdaantiin Paalastayinii Mahmuud Abbaas gumiin waliigalaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti hirmaachuuf gara Niiw Yoorkii imaluu akka hin dandeenye ta'eera. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, hoggantoonni Paalastayinii jijjiirama barbaadamu gochuu fi mootummaa ofii isaanii beekamtii argachuuf karaa mana murtii addunyaa deemuu isaaniitiin walqabatee akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: 'Few cards to play': Saudi Arabia faces limited options against Houthis with allies out
english: Saudi Arabia is struggling to counter increasing attacks from Houthi forces as it lacks strong international support. The Kingdom's oil infrastructure has been damaged by drones and missiles, and even sensitive religious sites like Mecca have been threatened. With the disabling of a key pipeline and constant aerial strikes, the Saudi government currently faces very few strategic options to defend its territory.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከአጋሮቿ ድጋፍ በማጣቷ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚሰነዘሩባትን ጥቃቶች ለመከላከል ተቸግራለች። በሳውዲ ዘይት ማስተላለፊያ መስመሮች ላይ በድሮንና በሚሳኤል የሚደርሰው ጉዳት ሀገሪቱን ለከፍተኛ ፈተና ዳርጓታል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተቀደሰችውን መካ ከተማን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ የሳውዲ አካባቢዎች ጥቃት እየሰነዘሩ በመሆኑ፣ የሳውዲ መንግስት ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ውስን አማራጮች ብቻ ቀርተውታል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan deeggarsa alaa dhabuu ishee irraa kan ka'e haleellaa garee Huutii ittisuun itti ulfaatee jira. Miidhaan bu'uraalee misoomaa boba'aa irratti qaqqabaa jiru fi haleellaan magaalota qulqulluu akka Makkaatti xiyyeeffachuu isaa gabaafameera. Haala kanaan, mootummaan Saudii qooda fudhannaa kanaan duraa dhabuun isaa, of ittisuuf filannoo muraasa qofa akka qabaatu isa godheera.

title: South Korea foreign minister says no decision made on Hormuz Strait military deployment
english: South Korea's foreign minister stated that the government has not yet decided whether to send military forces to the Strait of Hormuz. Officials are currently evaluating the situation, focusing on protecting their citizens and ensuring safe passage for ships. The country remains caught between pressure from the United States to join the mission and warnings from Iran regarding the potential consequences of such a move.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ወደ ሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ስለመላክ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ውሳኔ እንዳልተላለፈ ገለጹ። መንግስት የዜጎቹን ደህንነት እና የባህር መተላለፊያውን ነፃነት ከግምት ውስጥ በማስገባት ሁኔታውን እየገመገመ ነው። አገሪቱ በአንድ በኩል ከአሜሪካ የሚደርስባት ግፊት፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ከኢራን የሚሰነዘርባትን ማስጠንቀቂያ ከግምት በማስገባት ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት ውሳኔ ለመስጠት እየሞከረች ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa akka jedhutti, gara dhangala'aa galaana Hormuzitti waraana ergachuu ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti murtoon tokko hin irra ga'amne. Mootummaan fedhii lammiilee isaa fi nageenya karaa galaanichaa eeguuf jecha haalicha qorachaa jira. Biyyattiin dhiibbaa Ameerikaan irra geessisaa jirtuu fi akeekkachiisa Iraan irraa dhufe gidduutti murtoo of eeggannoo qabu gochuuf karoorfachaa jirti.

title: Will the UAE split from the rest of the GCC?
english: Experts are examining how the ongoing conflict involving Iran is influencing the foreign policies of Gulf nations. Analysts suggest that countries in the region may adopt a balanced strategy by simultaneously distancing themselves from the United States and limiting their ties with Iran. This potential shift could significantly alter political alignments across the Middle East.
amharic: ባለሙያዎች በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት የውጭ ግንኙነት ፖሊሲ ላይ ምን ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ እንዳለ እየገመገሙ ነው። የክልሉ አገራት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት በማላላት እና በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ከኢራን ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት በመገደብ ሚዛናዊ የሆነ አካሄድ ሊከተሉ እንደሚችሉ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ሊከሰት የሚችል የፖሊሲ ለውጥ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለውን የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ በእጅጉ ሊቀይረው ይችላል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin walqabatu biyyoota Gulf irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka geessisu qorachaa jiru. Biyyoonni naannichaa gama tokkoon Amerikaa irraa fagaachuufi gama biraatiin ammoo Iraan waliin walitti dhufeenya isaanii daangessuudhaan tarkaanfii madaalawaa fudhachuu akka danda'an yaadama. jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun naannoo Baha Giddugaleessaa keessatti hidhata siyaasaa gara fuulduraa jijjiiruu danda'a.

title: Israeli attacks reported across south Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces conducted a series of airstrikes and shelling operations across multiple locations in southern Lebanon throughout the night and into Thursday morning. These attacks targeted several towns, including al-Mansouri, al-Qantara, and Kfar Tebnit, causing significant explosions. The ongoing military activity has impacted various areas, creating widespread concern in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ አካባቢዎች ላይ ማክሰኞ ምሽት እና ሐሙስ ጠዋት የአየር ድብደባዎችን እና የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ ከፍተዋል። ድብደባው አል-ማንሱሪን፣ አል-ቃንታራን እና ከፍር ተብኒትን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ከተሞች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎችን አስከትሏል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በክልሉ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'eel halkan guutuu fi guyyaa Kamisaa ganama kutaa kibba Libaanoositti bakkeewwan hedduu irratti haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa gurguddaan haleelaniiru. Haleellaan kun magaalota akka Al-Mansuurii, Al-Qantaraa fi Kfaar Tebniit fa'i kanneen irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, dhoochaa cimaa uumeera. Gochi waraanaa kun naannichatti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Hormus Strait traffic drops to three vessels on Wednesday
english: Ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz saw a significant decline on Wednesday, with only three commodity vessels recorded. This figure is a sharp drop from the 12 ships observed the previous day and remains far below the usual average of 17. Experts noted that these tracking statistics might be incomplete, as some ships often disable their tracking devices to remain undetected.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚያልፉ የሸቀጥ መርከቦች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሶ ሶስት ብቻ ሆኗል። ይህ ቁጥር ከአንድ ቀን በፊት ከነበሩት 12 መርከቦች ጋር ሲነፃፀር ከፍተኛ ቅናሽ ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ከመደበኛው የ17 መርከቦች አማካይ በታች ነው። መረጃው የተሰበሰበው የመርከብ መከታተያ ቴክኖሎጂን በመጠቀም ቢሆንም፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች እንዳይታወቁ የራዳር መከታተያዎቻቸውን ሊያጠፉ ስለሚችሉ ትክክለኛው ቁጥር ሊለያይ ይችላል።
oromo: Guyyaa Roobii darbe keessa dooniiwwan gurguddoon daldalaa qarqara Hormuz irra deemanii dabran baay'inaan sadii qofa ta'aniiru. Lakkoofsi kun guyyaa tokko dura dooniiwwan 12 turan irraa kan hir'ate yoo ta'u, giddu-galeessa guyyoota kurnan darban keessa turan 17 irraas baay'ee gadi bu'eera. Gabaasni kun hordoffii dooniiwwanirratti kan hundaa'e ta'us, dooniiwwan tokko tokko hordoffii irraa of dhoksuuf qaxxaamuraasaanii ykn 'transponder' isaanii waan cufataniif, lakkoofsi sirrii ta'e garagara ta'uu danda'a.

title: NHL superstar Ovechkin ‘was asked’ to film Putin ad, team says
english: The Washington Capitals organization stated that NHL star Alex Ovechkin was requested by his home country to appear in a campaign video for Vladimir Putin’s political party. Ovechkin, who has a history of supporting the Russian president, featured in the promotional clip ahead of the nation's upcoming parliamentary elections. While the hockey team is focusing on the athlete’s upcoming season, the move has faced backlash due to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
amharic: የዋሽንግተን ካፒታልስ ቡድን የኤንኤችኤል ኮከብ አሌክስ ኦቬችኪን በፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ የማስተዋወቂያ ቪዲዮ ላይ እንዲታይ በአገሩ እንደተጠየቀ አስታውቋል። ቀደም ሲልም የፑቲን ደጋፊ በመባል የሚታወቀው ኦቬችኪን፣ በሩሲያ በተካሄደው ምርጫ ወቅት ለገዢው ፓርቲ ድጋፍ የሚሰጥ ቪዲዮ ላይ ታይቷል። ምንም እንኳን የቡድኑ አስተዳደር ትኩረታቸውን በስፖርታዊ ውድድሮች ላይ ለማድረግ ቢሞክሩም፣ ድርጊቱ በዩክሬን እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት አንጻር ከፍተኛ ትችቶችን አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Garee Waashingitan Kaapitaals akka ibsetti, taphataan beekamaa NHL Aleks Ovechkiin viidiyoo duula filannoo paartii Vladimir Puutiin irratti akka hirmaatu biyyasaa irraa gaafatamuu ibseera. Ovechkiin yeroo dheeraaf pirezidaanticha deggeraa kan ture yoo ta'u, filannoo biyyoolessaa biyyattii dursee viidiyoo paartii sanaa irratti mul'ateera. Gareen isaa xiyyeeffannoo isaa gara tapha kubbaa qoraa kanarratti taasisuuf yaaluus, hirmaannaan kun waraana Yukreen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee mormii cimaa kaasuu danda'eera.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US nearing end of war, claims Tehran direct talks
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the United States is approaching the conclusion of its conflict with Iran and claims to be engaged in direct communication with the Iranian government. Meanwhile, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres is calling for a reduction in tensions as violence escalates in the broader Middle East, particularly involving Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces in Yemen. U.S. military officials are currently monitoring the situation in Yemen while providing logistical support to their regional partners.

oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp waraanni Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru xumura isaa irra gahaa akka jiru ibsuun, mootummaa Iraan waliin kallattiidhaan mari'achaa akka jiran dubbataniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, Gulaaltuu Olaanaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guteereez, naannoo Baha Giddu galeessaatti, keessattuu Yamanitti waraanni hammaachaa waan jiruuf akka tasgabbaa'uufi karaa dippilomaasii akka hiikamu gaafataniiru. title: Israel and Morocco agree to open embassies, upgrading diplomatic ties
english: Israel and Morocco have officially decided to strengthen their diplomatic relationship by upgrading their missions to full embassies and appointing ambassadors. The two nations also plan to boost economic cooperation, finalize trade agreements, and resume direct commercial flights between their countries. This development, facilitated by the United States, aims to further regional peace and builds upon the progress made through the Abraham Accords.
amharic: እስራኤል እና ሞሮኮ ያላቸውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ወደ ሙሉ ኤምባሲ ደረጃ ከፍ ለማድረግ እና አምባሳደሮችን ለመቀያየር ተስማምተዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የኢኮኖሚ ትብብራቸውን ለማጠናከር፣ የንግድ ስምምነቶችን ለመፈራረም እና ቀጥተኛ የበረራ አገልግሎታቸውን እንደገና ለመጀመር ዕቅድ ይዘዋል። በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የተገኘው ይህ ስምምነት ለቀጠናዊ ሰላም ትልቅ ሚና ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Israa'el fi Morookoon hariiroo dippilomaasii isaanii sadarkaa ambaasaaddaraatti ol guddifachuuf walii galaniru. Biyyoonni lamaan kun guddina diinagdee jabeessuuf, waliigaltee daldalaa xumuruufi balaliidhaan karaa kallattii wal quunnamsiisuu jalqabuuf karoorfataniiru. Walii galteen kun deeggarsa Ameerikaatiin kan dhufe yoo ta'u, nagaa naannichaa mirkaneessuuf tarkaanfii bu'a qabeessa ta'a jedhamee eegama.

title: US military claims Strait of Hormuz remains open amid ongoing blockade
english: The US military reports that the Strait of Hormuz remains fully operational for international shipping despite ongoing tensions and regional blockades. Central Command officials state that they have successfully facilitated the transit of hundreds of millions of barrels of oil while actively managing the waterway. They maintain that the area is clear of mines and that US forces are effectively overseeing traffic to protect global energy supplies.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት እና ማዕቀብ ቢኖርም የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ለዓለም አቀፍ መርከቦች ክፍት እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ የባህር መንገዱን ደህንነት በመጠበቅ በቢሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ያለ ምንም ችግር እንዲያልፍ ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸዋል። የባህር መንገዱ ከፈንጂዎች የጸዳ መሆኑን እና አሜሪካ ዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን ለማረጋገጥ እንቅስቃሴውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለች መሆኗን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Ameerikaa, naannichatti walitti bu'iinsiifi gufuun jiruus, daandiin galaana Hormuz markeleef banaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ajajni giddugaleessaa Ameerikaa, daandii kana to'achuun isaan yeroo dhihoo asitti namusa boba'aa miliyoonaan lakkaa'amu gara gabaa addunyaatti darbuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Daandiin sun qulqulluu fi balaa irraa bilisa ta'uu ibsuun, Ameerikaan dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa eeguuf balaliin galaana sun akka hin cufamne hordofaa jiraachuu ibsameera.
